items.title: Mark Soskin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 17, 2021
items.q: Stanley Turrentine I didn’t get paid very well. And that was always an issue. And you know what? I one time, I said to Stanley, “Hey Stanley, I think we should get paid more.”

ctx.x: Oh. Not getting paid is always not good. And I always keep that stuff in mind. Oh yeah. Definitely. And usually that’s done well in advance you know. So like I’ll know what I’m going to get paid and I know what everybody else is going to get, you know? So now I’m doing this gig at Small’s, I know how much they’re going to get paid. And when I’m at the gig, here’s what you’re going to get. Boom. And I pay them. And usually they’re very happy with what I pay them. And that’s something else, you know, to have a band…

Good. I’m going to add that to my vocabulary. The Squeeze. I noticed you’ve done some arranging, Slide Hampton and other people. Did you make a transition from using pencil and paper to using Finale or Sibelius?
